scripts.dev:server: cd apps/server && ZENDILOHUB_PORT=${ZENDILOHUB_PORT:-8096} ZENDILOHUB_DATABASE_URL=${ZENDILOHUB_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://zendilohub:zendilohub@localhost:5443/zendilohub} ZENDILOHUB_REDIS_URL=${ZENDILOHUB_REDIS_URL:-redis://localhost:6390/0} uv run zendilohub serve
scripts.check:server: cd apps/server && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy src tests && uv run pytest --cov
